data.title: Hundreds Chart Hop
data.description: Embark on an exciting adventure to fill in the missing steps and reveal the hidden trails across the chart.

challenges.instruction: The first 3 numbers are highlighted. Tap all the remaining numbers in the pattern up to 100.
challenges.hint: Look closely at the distance between each step to find the rhythm of the path.
